This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.439 of CrPC by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Chakapada PS Case No.139 of 2023 corresponding to CT Case No.584 of 2023 pending in the file of learned JMFC, G. Udayagiri, for commission of offences punishable under Sections 302/201/120(B)/376(D)/506 of IPC, on the main allegation of assisting the co- accused to commit murder of the deceased.

3. Heard, Mr. Sarada Prasad Dash, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. A.K. Apat, learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4. After having considered the rival submissions and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioner vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against her and regard being had to the specific allegation against the petitioner for remaining present at the time of commission of crime and taking into account the other circumstances on record in entirety, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.
Hence, the bail application of the petitioner stands rejected.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
5. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
